content.short: Algebra Protocol provides concentrated liquidity AMM infrastructure with dynamic fees and built-in farming modules for DEXes building on Mantle.
content.description: Algebra Protocol is a concentrated liquidity DEX infrastructure layer enabling other DEX projects to deploy capital-efficient pools with advanced features including dynamic fee adjustment based on market volatility, built-in farming and incentive modules, and a plugin-based architecture for extensibility. Multiple DEXes on Mantle use Algebra's smart contracts as their core AMM engine, making it a foundational piece of infrastructure for the network's decentralized exchange ecosystem.
